Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target.     "resolution": "The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new lock. Failure: the gaze locks. While locked, the target cannot voluntarily avert its primary gaze from you or deliberately close, cover or otherwise block its relevant visual organs in a manner that would meaningfully break or evade the maintained gaze, regardless of the stated reason for doing so. Ordinary momentary blinking that does not meaningfully break mutual visual contact remains possible. An actual involuntary loss of sight or visual contact can end the lock normally.",
    "effect": "While the lock remains, treat the target as looking at/meeting your gaze for a separate rule that expressly asks that question. This spell supplies no gaze attack of its own and creates no universal facing or field-of-view system. The target can move, attack, cast, interact, choose other legal targets and perceive through ordinary peripheral or other senses normally. It gains no generic attack/Perception disadvantage and loses no Action, Reaction or movement. It is not compelled to follow you to preserve range or sight.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.",
    "limitations": "End the lock immediately if you and the target exceed 30 feet, actual line of effect or mutual visual contact breaks, either becomes unable to maintain the relevant sight, or you voluntarily end the gaze; voluntary release requires no extra Action. This includes actual Blindness or an outside intervention that blocks the required view. A creature with no eyes can qualify only if its actual sense/anatomy supplies a genuine directed-gaze analogue; a creature name or theme cannot invent one. One active Beguiling Gaze per caster; a later failed target save replaces that caster’s prior lock. A successful target save does not itself replace the old lock, but actually breaking prior contact to establish a new gaze can end the old lock independently. An ended lock never resumes merely because distance or sight later returns. Other exact gaze powers retain their own costs, saves, targeting, effects and defenses; the lock bypasses none except the expressly prevented voluntary aversion. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.",
    "designNotes": "PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S, mutual eye lock and inability to look away for one round. NEW: WIS save, real gaze analogue, maintained contact/range, voluntary-aversion rule and exact first-future-target-turn endpoint. No generic facing engine, compelled approach or hard whole-Action denial is imported.",
    "implementationStatus": "REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending",

    "resolution": "No roll. Privately learn the precise position and boundary of each actual qualifying concealed passage entrance in range, subject to specific Divination protections.",
    "effect": "Qualifying features include secret doors, hidden trapdoors, movable concealed panels, hidden passage openings and comparable intentionally concealed entrances. Ordinary walls, paneling, masonry, furniture and visual concealment do not block this specific entry-detection procedure. An actual entrance hidden by an illusion can be revealed without granting knowledge of unrelated illusion properties. The detection can identify an entrance behind an intervening ordinary wall if that entrance itself is within30feet; it does not require the caster already to see its concealing surface.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.",
    "limitations": "It reveals the entry, not a map of the passage network or rooms beyond it. A buried tunnel without a qualifying entrance in range is not mapped merely for passing nearby. No door or tunnel is created where the fiction has none. There is no unlocking, opening, trap detection/disarming, knowledge of a trigger mechanism, construction history, route beyond range, treasure report or persistent public outline. The knowledge is an instantaneous private spatial snapshot, not tracking or sight through all surrounding matter. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.",

You gain advantage on actual Persuasion checks directed to this target specifically concerning that faction, its interests or cooperation with it. Ordinary beliefs, evidence, risk judgment, task legality and agency remain. End the application when you, or a creature the target actually recognizes as acting for this faction, commits an attack or knowingly harmful effect against the target, before the outcome; a later miss/prevention does not restore it. Unknown affiliation alone is not an omniscient ending trigger.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.",
    "limitations": "The faction is snapshotted at application; your later membership/leadership changes do not retarget or automatically end it. This is not Core Charmed, a command, numeric reputation, membership, credential, authority, legal rights, permanent loyalty or erasure of grievances. Each caster/target/faction has one affinity record; later failed save refreshes that matching record, success leaves an existing one unchanged. Different factions/casters may have independent feelings and deadlines; advantage still never stacks and conflicting interests grant no compelled choice. No ongoing30foot or communication tether; actual Persuasion still needs an ordinary interaction. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.",
    "designNotes": "PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,M/F as focus, strong faction affinity1hour, no source concentration. NEW: WIS, actual-affiliation predicate, genuine but bounded attitude, related Persuasion advantage and recognized-harm ending. Exact completion allows independent different faction relations without granting allegiance or stacked advantage.",

    "concentration": false,

      "S",

    "resolution": "Conjure one noncurrency Tiny magical coin, AC10/HP1, mass0.01pound. A current holder with a usable hand may flip and expend it as a Reaction after the complete original roll event has been rolled and its die faces are available under ordinary table information rules, but before that roll's mechanical consequences are applied. Choose one physical die from that completed original roll and reroll only it. There is no separate heads/tails success test. The coin vanishes and its use commits when the legal Reaction begins.",
    "effect": "The holder must perceive the creature/object generating the roll or the actual local event being resolved, within 30 feet and line of effect. Physical tabletop dice location is irrelevant. The roll can belong to the holder, an ally or an enemy; no target consent is required. Its result must actually be available to the reacting player under the table’s normal information rules; the coin does not reveal secret rolls or fabricate perception. Choose one physical die from that original roll. Reroll only it and use the new face: for two-d20 advantage/disadvantage reselect the higher/lower normally; for a multi-die damage, healing or resource pool recompute the original total; for a single-die attack/check/save use its new face. All original modifiers, other dice, target selection and source rules remain. If the roll is shared across targets, use the same modified shared result for all of them. An initial Resonance Well reserve d4 may be changed before the reserve is established, but an already established reserve cannot be rerolled or refilled.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.",
    "limitations": "One active Fate Coin per caster; successful recasting replaces the previous unspent coin wherever it is. Ordinary handing/dropping/custody and hands apply; a handoff never refreshes the charge, endpoint or caster cap. The spell adds no separate one-coin-per-holder cap: several casters may supply distinct coins, still constrained by actual hands, Reactions and the shared roll guard. At0HP, expiry or replacement, this conjured coin vanishes without creating material; it is not currency, sellable stock or a component. Its native HP is not an Integrity conversion. Ordinary Reaction prohibitions apply. A prevented committed use is not refunded. No already-resolved hit, HP loss, healing, RP grant/transfer, cost or completed outcome can be reversed. The spell grants no character-generation rewrite, out-of-fiction table control, automatic access to hidden Director dice or extra reroll of the entire pool. Mark Omen and Fate Coin share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from either of these two spells, across all casters, coins, marks and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these two spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use a fixed neutral table order chosen before the roll. Only the first legal commitment spends a mark/coin; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.",

NEW: Reaction/30foot perceived-event interface, one mandatory replacement face, one caster coin, shared Mark Omen/Fate Coin roll-lineage guard. If initiative begins while onset is pending, map onset to the next actual regular target START even if before original +6; expiry is the earlier of that affected regular END and original +12. No +6 not-before floor remains, and reaching +12 first ends the pending rider without later activation. If initiative begins after outside onset has occurred, the active rider simply retains its original +12 expiry, with no new full-turn window. Effects initially created in initiative preserve both original future START and corresponding END as virtual markers on exit; no restart. Extra turns neither activate nor consume these regular markers, but an already-active rider affects movement during an extra turn within its active interval. A hit establishes the independent rider under its own defenses even if the damage is reduced to 0; immunity to the damage type alone does not prevent that rider. A later independent application retains its own endpoint; ending one removes only that application, and equal penalties/prohibitions do not stack magnitude. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing.     "duration": "Up to 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.",
    "concentration": false,
    "components": [
      "V",
      "S"
    ],
    "resolution": "No save is added. After costs commit, determine whether the chosen creature is actually non-hostile toward you. If not, create no benefit and give no separate hostility diagnostic. If eligible, you gain advantage on actual Charisma checks directly interacting with that creature for the duration.",
    "effect": "The benefit includes whatever actual Charisma skill/task is legitimately used in that interaction, not only Persuasion or Deception. It does not grant an otherwise unavailable check or determine its outcome. If the creature becomes actually hostile toward you while the application lasts, this application ends and does not resume merely because its attitude later improves. Hidden but established hostility is still actual; a faction, species, alignment, reputation score, appearance or suspicion alone does not establish it. One active Friends target per caster; a successful eligible new application replaces the old one. A cast that creates no eligible benefit does not itself replace an existing valid application.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.",
    "limitations": "This is a caster-side social benefit, not Charmed, an unwilling-to-harm restriction or control of choices/beliefs. No advantage on attacks, saves, ordinary spellcasting or unrelated checks. Written broader mental/Enchantment defenses retain their actual scope. No automatic post-expiry hostility, notification, friendship, loyalty, confession or reputation change is added. Ordinary observers can notice casting and infer things from actual interactions; the spell does not erase those observations. After initial legal application there is no continuing 30-foot tether, but any actual interaction still needs its normal communication and task permissions. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.",

Outside initiative, the first pulse is application+6 seconds and then at most once each 6 seconds while actually used; preserve the next not-before deadline through initiative changes, and never award an extra pulse merely by entering or leaving initiative. Whenever this spell deals a pulse, record a next-pulse-not-before deadline 6 elapsed seconds after that pulse. No later pulse from this spell on this physical item can occur before that deadline, even if initiative begins, ends or is reordered. In initiative, after that deadline, the first otherwise eligible current-user regular-start in a numbered round may pulse, subject to the shared item/round guard. Leaving initiative preserves the same deadline; the first outside-initiative pulse cannot occur before it. Entering or leaving initiative never resets either the deadline or a spent item/round allowance. The physical item retains this deadline across replacement applications/casters just as it retains the shared round allowance. Mere touching by another creature is not wearing/holding use. Dropping, legally doffing, melding or losing actual item use prevents damage while that state lasts without ending concentration or resetting the spell clock. A later user may take a later legal pulse. Normal armor removal time and legal custody still apply. No forced drop, disadvantage, Bonus Action pulse, Burn, ignition, object damage or additional condition. Supernatural damaging heat ends with the spell; no residual damage clock. Recasting does not produce an instant pulse or erase a spent item/round allowance. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of an older application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting a concentration spell still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, components, line of effect, RP and other costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. NEW named interaction: only for the ordinary Shield spell’s expressly named Magic Missile exception, this spell counts as Magic Missile. At committed allocation each distinct recipient supplies one such Shield targeting opportunity for this Storm, available before that recipient’s first missile damage resolves. A willing eligible recipient can be protected by a legal Shield cast within its own actual30-foot/source/repertoire/Reaction rules; Shield has its normal cost and nested counter window.     "targets": "One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; declare one simple single-purpose idea and a language in which you can formulate it.",
    "duration": "Up to 1 minute of mental salience, no concentration; one Persuasion-check benefit may be consumed earlier. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.",
    "concentration": false,
    "components": [
      "V",
      "S"
    ],
    "resolution": "After costs commit, resolve whether the target actually understands the chosen language and the declared idea is harmless in the actual circumstances. A hidden incompatibility or hazard creates no planted idea and gives no diagnostic of its reason. Otherwise the target makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Success: no new effect. Failure: the idea appears in its conscious mind as a plausible, salient option for the duration; it can freely reject that option. It need not hear the verbal component to receive the mental idea, but V/S casting requirements still apply.",
    "effect": "For the duration, you have advantage on your first actual Persuasion check directed to the target specifically to encourage that exact idea; consume that benefit when the check begins even if advantage was already present or disadvantage cancels it. The idea’s temporary salience can remain until expiry after the benefit is consumed. One active Minor Suggestion per caster/target pair; a later successful implant replaces the old idea/benefit/endpoint without accumulating several suggestions from that caster. Other casters retain separate records without stacking advantage on one roll. The spell does not make its subject believe the idea is true or necessarily its own invention, erase awareness of observed casting, or force any decision.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.",
    "limitations": "Harmlessness is judged from actual circumstances, not caster phrasing. Reject ideas that directly require self-harm, harming another creature, entering an actual meaningful hazard, surrendering/discarding materially valuable property, revealing a protected/private secret, a hostile act, or knowingly violating a binding oath/duty. If changed circumstances make the proposed act non-harmless before expiry, end its magical salience and unused bonus without revealing the hidden reason. Ordinary memory that the idea was presented remains. No compelled Action, movement, obedience, Charmed, confession, dispossession, eight-hour command, permanent belief/memory replacement or truth verification occurs. Actual social-task legality still governs whether a Persuasion check exists and what success means. A later saved/invalid cast does not erase an existing valid application merely by being attempted. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.",
    "designNotes": "PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V,S and a simple harmless idea planted in the mind. NEW: language compatibility, WIS save, one-minute salience and one Persuasion-check advantage. Exact completions defer hidden compatibility/harmlessness to post-payment resolution, add one application per caster/target, and end magic if the actual proposal becomes harmful.",
    "implementationStatus": "REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending",

Recasting a materially equivalent inquiry about the same subject or proposed action while the materially relevant circumstances remain unchanged gives the same omen or a restatement, without cumulative extra detail. This equivalence applies across casters: rephrasing the inquiry, passing it to another caster, or subdividing it solely to extract additional detail about the same issue does not create new information. A genuinely different material question about that subject, or a material change in circumstances, may produce a different omen.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.",
    "limitations": "It does not guarantee future decisions, dice or events not yet caused, compel anyone to enact a predicted outcome, reveal a whole stat block/inventory/plot or automatically succeed at a task. New voluntary actions or genuinely new causes may make a previously truthful omen obsolete. Rephrasing the same inquiry, switching casters or serially subdividing it does not create extra information from an unchanged omen; use the same materially equivalent subject/circumstance boundary. No additional daily use cap is added. If all relevant information is specifically protected, the Director gives only an uninformative opaque omen without naming the protection; permitted information about other subjects remains available. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.",
    "designNotes": "PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S/instantaneous and a cryptic supernatural tip. NEW: bounded subject/action input, one truthful usable private clue, current-circumstances scope and no incremental detail for materially repeated inquiry. No universal future-certainty or spirit-contact ability.",

    "resolution": "No roll. Privately learn Yes if at least one creature, object, area or active effect within the sensing area currently bears an explicit canonical Corruption record/tag/state that this detection is permitted to read. Otherwise learn No.",
    "effect": "Actual hidden Corruption is valid spell information and yields Yes when unprotected. Total cover blocks the relevant part of the sensing area. Undefined/missing records do not establish Corruption and do not create a numeric value. A specific masking/protection effect excludes only the information within its written scope; it does not announce that masking occurred. A No result means no permitted positive presence was detected, not proof that no protected Corruption could exist.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.",
    "limitations": "This reveals no direction, distance, location, count, identity, type, severity, numeric track, cause, hidden consequence or cure. Alignment, disease, ordinary poison, faction, reputation, crime or creature species does not itself establish Corruption. No fear, damage, attack permission, protection, healing, harvest right or new global Corruption clock is created. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.",
    "designNotes": "PRESERVED: Action/V,S/instantaneous and presence within30feet. NEW: Self casting origin, same-plane30-foot line-of-effect area, exact canonical positive predicate and strictly Yes/No output. Existing Detect Corruption and sensor interfaces remain separate named spells.",

    "duration": "Concentration, up to 1 minute. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier with concentration; no glow survives the ward.",
    "concentration": true,
    "components": [
      "V",
      "S",
      "F"
    ],
    "resolution": "No roll. At each actual outside-to-inside entry, the Director determines whether that creature has an actual current hostile relationship toward you in the encounter/campaign state. A qualifying entry starts or refreshes the visible signal for 6 elapsed seconds from that entry, capped by the ward’s own endpoint.",
    "effect": "Place one faintly visible magical sigil watching a fixed area 10 feet in radius and 10 feet high above its surface. Qualifying hostility may be secret if it is an actual current fictional fact; do not infer it from species, alignment, faction, reputation, appearance or suspicion. Undefined hostility does not become hostile merely to trigger the spell. Entry includes voluntary movement, forced movement and teleportation that actually occupies the area. Creation around an already-present creature is not entry; it must leave and reenter. Ordinary intervening cover within the area does not prevent physical entry from triggering, but a protection blocking the creature’s new Divination information can prevent its trigger. During a signal the mark is self-luminous and visible under ordinary line-of-sight rules; it does not illuminate surrounding squares. Its only direct report is that at least one qualifying entry occurred recently. Repeated entries refresh the same signal, without separate counted pulses or a stored log.",
    "scaling": "None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.",
    "limitations": "One Warning Ward per caster. The area stays fixed; moving or destroying its supporting surface ends the ward rather than making a portable detector. Ending concentration or suppressing the ward prevents new signals and removes its visible glow; suppression does not pause the ward’s duration or replay missed entries when it ends. A formerly signaled entry is not a new entry just because suppression ends. No damage, restraint, sound alarm, creature outline, square, count, identity, type, statistics or detailed intention is reported. Actual observers can make ordinary inferences from the glow and its timing. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed.
